# John Meredith & Rosemary West

- [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) — Romantically involved with — [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) — he asked her to marry him and considers her the only woman in the world for him · since v5  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XXI. ## Shared scenes

> [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) encounters [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) by a secluded, sacred spring in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), where he makes her a birch-bark cup to drink from. They walk back to her home together, conversing easily, and Mr. Meredith goes inside to borrow a book. After discussing European politics with [Ellen West](../character/ellen-west.md) and taking his leave, [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) accuses [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) of being courted by the minister.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XIII. THE HOUSE ON THE HILL

> [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) and John discuss European politics and [German](../codex/factions.md#german) militarism before John leaves. Afterward, [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) warns [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) that John seems interested in courting her, reminding her of a promise she made. [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) is irritated by the warning and retires to her room feeling unsettled as autumn begins.
>

> [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) becomes deeply absorbed in studying [German](../codex/factions.md#german) theology, resulting in complete distraction from his pastoral and domestic duties. Mrs. [Alec Davis](../character/alec-davis.md) arrives at the manse and abruptly demands to adopt [Una](../character/una-meredith.md), which Mr. Meredith firmly refuses. Outraged, Mrs. [Davis](../character/davis.md) berates him for neglecting his children, leaving him shaken and reflecting on how to properly care for his family.
>

> After [Dan Reese](../character/dan-reese.md) insults [Faith](../character/faith.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Walter Blythe](../character/walter-blythe.md) confronts him and agrees to a fight the next evening. Despite his dread, Walter wins the battle after school, defending [Faith](../character/faith.md) and his mother. On his way home through [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), he meets Mr. Meredith, who approves of his fighting for a good cause, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later comforts him after hearing what happened.

> In [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), [Faith](../character/faith.md) meets [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md), who warmly comforts her about the death of her pet rooster, [Adam](../character/adam.md), and promises to give her a canary. [Faith](../character/faith.md) returns home feeling comforted and enthusiastically praises Miss West to her family during supper.

> [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) walks to the [West](../character/west.md) home in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), intending to propose to [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) while her sister [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) is away at a silver wedding. [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) prepares to receive him with dread, knowing she must reject his proposal because of a solemn vow she made to [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) ten years earlier never to marry.
>

> [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) recalls the solemn vow she made to her sister [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) ten years ago never to marry. When [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) unexpectedly proposes to her, she finds herself unable to refuse him directly because she realizes she loves him, so she asks him for a few days to consider.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XXI. THE IMPOSSIBLE WORD

> [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) returns home from a party where she enjoyed a lively argument with [Norman Douglas](../character/norman-douglas.md). Upon arriving, [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) reveals that [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) proposed to her and begs [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) to release her from her solemn promise never to marry, but [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) fiercely refuses. [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) sends John a cold refusal, leaving both [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) and John heartbroken while [Ellen](../character/ellen-west.md) tries to justify her refusal to her cat.
>

> [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md) visits [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) to ask her to marry her father, [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md), willing to risk having a stepmother for her father's happiness. [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) reassures [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) that she will be a friend rather than a cruel stepmother and gives her a note for her father, which restores John Meredith's spirits upon receiving it.
